title: PORTABLE MILKING MACHINE
text:
Sickle is used for harvesting, or reaping, grain crops or cutting succulent forage mainly for feeding livestock, either freshly cut or dried as hay.

Fencer graft is used for post hole digging.

The Portable milking machine is composed of two parts, a milking machine and a vacuum device, It is used for collecting milk from cows and goats. This machine is easy to operate, flexible, convenient, and has reliable performance. It is an ideal milking equipment necessary for medium and small dairy farms and professional dairy farmers to perceive modern milking of dairy cows.

facts: A sickle is used for harvesting, or reaping, grain crops or cutting succulent forage mainly for feeding livestock, either freshly cut or dried as hay.
A fencer graft is used for post hole digging.
The portable milking machine is composed of two main parts: a milking machine and a vacuum device.
The portable milking machine is used for collecting milk from cows and goats.
The portable milking machine is described as easy to operate, flexible, convenient, and has reliable performance.
The portable milking machine is an ideal milking equipment necessary for medium and small dairy farms and professional dairy farmers to achieve modern milking.
Components labeled on the portable milking machine include: Barometer, Pulsator, Air Pressure Regulating Valve, Air Tank, Vacuum Pump, Motor, Wheel, Milk Tank, Milk Hose, and Air Hose.
